scripts.build:wasm: swiftly run swift build --package-path ../.. --swift-sdk swift-6.3.1-RELEASE_wasm --product CloudflareDatabaseRuntime -c release +6.3.1
scripts.test: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && node --test
scripts.smoke:e2e: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && node scripts/smoke-e2e.mjs
scripts.smoke:local:persistence: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && node scripts/smoke-local-persistence.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build:wasm && npm run prepare:wasm && wrangler deploy --dry-run
